events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: American-British singer-songwriter Chrissie Hynde, best known as the frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Hynde's Enduring Influence
angles.copy: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic voice of The Pretenders, is 75 today. Her distinctive style and powerful songwriting have left an indelible mark on rock music. What's your favourite track from her incredible career?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer and songwriter Liam Gallagher, famed as the lead vocalist of Oasis and later Beady Eye, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, he remains one of British rock's most recognisable figures. What's your top Liam moment?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 'Dr. No' first hit screens, the world's most famous secret agent continues to captivate. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary English musician, singer, and songwriter John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: John Lennon would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate globally. What's the John Lennon song that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and Monty Python co-founder John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is undeniable. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead singer of Queen, who died on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy continue to inspire. What's your favourite Queen song featuring Freddie?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', featuring tracks like 'Drive My Car' and 'Norwegian Wood', was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: A Pivotal Album
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a significant shift in their sound. What's your standout track from this classic?

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who was fatally shot on December 8, 1980, in New York City.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace endure. We remember his incredible impact on music and culture.
